property_summary: Ownership in C is recoverable: a transferOwnership attempt with the zero address must fail without destroying ownership, so the (still) owner can always afterwards successfully transfer to a nonzero address; the mutant accepts the zero-address transfer, sets owner()=0, and thereby makes every subsequent owner-only transfer revert.
change_summary: Remove the zero-address check so ownership can be transferred to address(0), which is observable via owner().
